captureType: public production bundle plus embedded Object3D.toJSON models
notes: The bundle is a build artifact; original authoring source, server-side code, and source maps were not exposed.
Audio and voice files are not bundled into this skill because they are not needed for modeling reference.
Use extracted material only for research, compatibility testing, and proportion study; obtain permission for redistribution or commercial use.
coreRule: The standard model (reference/iE.json) is the base. Reference images only supply details (clothes, hair, palette, props). Adapt reference images to the standard's look, never rebuild the standard's proportions from an image.

standardProject.purpose: Canonical standard project: loads the standard model, switches variants, toggles categories, wireframe, live triangle stats.
